lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਨੋ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਐ ਸਾਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekhan sunan sunaavano man mahi driReeai saach ||
lines.translation: See, hear, speak and implant the True Lord within your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: poor rahio sarabatr mai naanak har ra(n)g raach ||2||
lines.translation: He is all-pervading, permeating everywhere; O Nanak, be absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ek nira(n)jan gaaeeai sabh a(n)tar soee ||
lines.translation: Sing the Praise of the One, the Immaculate Lord; He is contained within all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath prabh jo kare s hoee ||
lines.translation: The Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord God; whatever He wills, comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi thaap uthaapadaa tis bin nahee koee ||
lines.translation: In an instant, He establishes and disestablishes; without Him, there is no other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਦੀਪ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d paataal deep raviaa sabh loee ||
lines.translation: He pervades the continents, solar systems, nether worlds, islands and all worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੁਝਸੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis aap bujhaae so bujhasee niramal jan soee ||1||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself instructs; he alone is a pure and unstained being. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਚੰਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਰਚਨਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਅਸਥਾਪਨੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: racha(n)t jee rachanaa maat garabh asathaapana(n) ||
lines.translation: Creating the soul, the Lord places this creation in the womb of the mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas simara(n)t naanak mahaa agan na binaasana(n) ||1||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, it meditates in remembrance on the Lord, O Nanak; it is not consumed by the great fire. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖੁ ਤਲੈ ਪੈਰ ਉਪਰੇ ਵਸੰਦੋ ਕੁਹਥੜੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh talai pair upare vasa(n)do kuhathaRai thaai ||
lines.translation: With its head down, and feet up, it dwells in that slimy place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so dhanee kiu visaario udharahi jis dai naai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, how could we forget the Master? Through His Name, we are saved. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: rakat bi(n)d kar ni(n)miaa agan udar majhaar ||
lines.translation: From egg and sperm, you were conceived, and placed in the fire of the womb.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖੁ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਬਿਕਲੁ ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: uradh mukh kucheel bikal narak ghor gubaar ||
lines.translation: Head downwards, you abided restlessly in that dark, dismal, terrible hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੂ ਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har simarat too naa jalahi man tan ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: Remembering the Lord in meditation, you were not burnt; enshrine Him in your heart, mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਥਾਨਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikham thaanahu jin rakhiaa tis til na visaar ||
lines.translation: In that treacherous place, He protected and preserved you; do not forget Him, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾਸਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: prabh bisarat sukh kade naahi jaasahi janam haar ||2||
lines.translation: Forgetting God, you shall never find peace; you shall forfeit your life, and depart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛਾ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ichhaa daan karana(n) sarabatr aasaa pooranah ||
lines.translation: He grants our hearts' desires, and fulfills all our hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡਣੰ ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹ ਦੂਰਣਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)dana(n) kal kalesah prabh simar naanak nah dooranah ||1||
lines.translation: He destroys pain and suffering; remember God in meditation, O Nanak - He is not far away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਈਐ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: habh ra(n)g maanahi jis sa(n)g tai siu laaeeai nehu ||
lines.translation: Love Him, with whom you enjoy all pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਰਚਿਆ ਦੇਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so sahu bi(n)d na visarau naanak jin su(n)dar rachiaa dehu ||2||
lines.translation: Do not forget that Lord, even for an instant; O Nanak, He fashioned this beautiful body. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਦੀਨੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeu praan tan dhan deeaa deene ras bhog ||
lines.translation: He gave you your soul, breath of life, body and wealth; He gave you pleasures to enjoy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਥ ਅਸੁ ਦੀਏ ਰਚਿ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: grih ma(n)dar rath as deee rach bhale sa(n)jog ||
lines.translation: He gave you households, mansions, chariots and horses; He ordained your good destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਦੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਵਨ ਜੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: sut banitaa saajan sevak deee prabh devan jog ||
lines.translation: He gave you your children, spouse, friends and servants; God is the all-powerful Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਜੋਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: har simarat tan man hariaa lahi jaahi vijog ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the body and mind are rejuvenated, and sorrow departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g har gun ramahu binase sabh rog ||3||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chant the Praises of the Lord, and all your sickness shall vanish. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਟੰਬ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਣੰ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਨੇਕ ਉਦਮਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: kuta(n)b jatan karana(n) maaiaa anek udamah ||
lines.translation: For his family, he works very hard; for the sake of Maya, he makes countless efforts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਹੀਣੰ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਤਤਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagat bhaav heena(n) naanak prabh bisarat te pretatah ||1||
lines.translation: But without loving devotional worship of the Lord, O Nanak, he forgets God, and then, he is a mere ghost. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਟੜੀਆ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜੋ ਲਾਈ ਬਿਅੰਨ ਸਿਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tutaReeaa saa preet jo laaee bia(n)n siu ||
lines.translation: That love shall break, which is established with any other than the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachee reet saa(n)ee setee ratiaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that way of life is true, which inspires love of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤਨੁ ਭਸਮ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis bisarat tan bhasam hoi kahate sabh pret ||
lines.translation: Forgetting Him, one's body turns to dust, and everyone calls him a ghost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਬਸਨ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੋਈ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin grih mahi basan na devahee jin siu soee het ||
lines.translation: And those, with whom he was so much in love - they do not let him stay in their home, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨਰਥ ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਸੋ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar anarath darab sa(n)chiaa so kaaraj ket ||
lines.translation: Practicing exploitation, he gathers wealth, but what use will it be in the end?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beejai so lunai karam ihu khet ||
lines.translation: As one plants, so does he harvest; the body is the field of actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਿਰਤਘਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਰਮੇਤੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: akirataghanaa har visariaa jonee bharamet ||4||
lines.translation: The ungrateful wretches forget the Lord, and wander in reincarnation. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਦਾਨ ਇਸਨਾਨੰ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੋਧਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot daan isanaana(n) anik sodhan pavitratah ||
lines.translation: The benefits of millions of charitable donations and cleansing baths, and countless ceremonies of purification and piety,

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਚਰੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਮੁਚਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: uchara(n)t naanak har har rasanaa sarab paap bimuchate ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, are obtained by chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har with one's tongue; all sins are washed away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਧਣੁ ਕੀਤੋਮੂ ਘਣਾ ਭੋਰੀ ਦਿਤੀਮੁ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: eedhan keetomoo ghanaa bhoree diteem bhaahi ||
lines.translation: I gathered together a great stack of firewood, and applied a tiny flame to light it.
